answer: Sybil resistance can bind each agent identity to a depletable bond that burns on dishonest attestations. A newcomer must lease a scarce jetty slot by locking capital that unlocks only after a sustained honest pulse of countersignatures; cloning identities multiplies both the lock and slash exposure. An orchard of randomly drawn graders then samples submissions: flooding fake accounts costs linear capital per clone plus expected slash when coordinated voting is detected, so attack spend exceeds the payoff of capturing consensus.
